target_customer: Engineering teams running several AI coding agents who want persistent sandboxed VMs on their own machines or cloud accounts
problem: Coding agents need isolated, stateful machines with repos, credentials and preview URLs. Amika turns spare computers or cloud accounts into devboxes and CI runners.
business_model: Open source core with a hosted cloud; free for teams of 3 or fewer on their own hardware, paid hosted devboxes and larger teams
product_category: Cloud devboxes and sandboxes for AI coding agents

founders.name: Dylan Mikus
education: Carnegie Mellon University, computer science and ML
previous_startups: Earlier YC company (name not stated on YC page; listed as 2x YC founder)

founders.name: Jakub Cichon
previous_startups: Earlier YC company (name not stated on YC page; listed as 2x YC founder)

competitors.name: Runloop
competitors.what: Devbox environments for AI coding agents

technical_complexity.rationale: Slicing machines into isolated VMs, a private mesh network, snapshots and persistent state for agents is systems engineering with hard isolation and networking problems.

defensibility.rationale: Open source primitives and many sandbox vendors, including E2B, Daytona, Modal and Runloop, mean competitors are well funded; bring-your-own-hardware is a differentiator but copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Funded sandbox providers already served coding agents by 2025, and cloud and code platforms also offer sandboxes; later comparison posts list over 15 providers.

market_need_then: Coding agents multiplied in 2025 and teams needed isolated environments to run and verify agent code; YC launch post frames it as the infrastructure large firms built in house.

branding.domain_note: Uses amika.dev; the amika.com space is held by an established hair care brand (loveamika.com).

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and practical, for example Think Tailscale meets Kubernetes (but simple!)

branding.community_and_virality: Open source core at github.com/gofixpoint/amika; no merch or community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly short name but search results are dominated by a hair care brand of the same name, and no brand press about the startup was found.

pivots.from: Earlier YC company by the same founders (not named in sources)
pivots.why: One search summary mentions a pivot from their earlier YC company; no details or date found

outcome_analysis: Amika is an active two person team of repeat YC founders from the Fall 2025 batch in the crowded market for agent sandboxes. The bring your own compute and open source approach is distinctive, but well funded rivals exist and no funding is verified, so the outcome is open.
notes: No funding found beyond the YC badge; aggregators show none. The page footer lists the company as Fixpoint, Inc. The branding search returned only an unrelated hair care company named Amika, which was ignored. The earlier YC company is not named in sources opened. Competition limited to one dated source near the batch.
